antcolonies.configuration.adultLifespanM: Average minutes an adult ant lives. A colony without a Queen dwindles; with one, eggs replace the dead.
antcolonies.configuration.ant3DModels.to: Draw the ants on top of a Terrarium as 3D models up close. False draws them as 2D sprites like the ants in the tunnels: they look flatter but cost far less, which helps with many colonies in view.
antcolonies.configuration.antDetailDista: Blocks within which the ants on top of a Terrarium are 3D models (if ant3DModels is on); further away (where they are a pixel or two) they are 2D sprites, which are far cheaper to draw.
antcolonies.configuration.barracksCapaci: Soldiers each Soldier Barracks houses. Without barracks a colony raises no soldiers.
antcolonies.configuration.baseEggsPerMin: Eggs a Queen with average genetics lays per minute with one Breeding Chamber.
antcolonies.configuration.baseMutationCh: Chance a daughter Queen is born with a random mutation (before Mutation Probability).
Stacked bonuses (genetics x mutations x upgrades) above 1 count as bonus^exponent, so they can't multiply without end. 1 = no softening; 0.6 turns x20 into x6.
antcolonies.configuration.breedingChambe: Egg laying added by each Breeding Chamber after the first (diminishing).
antcolonies.configuration.connectorFoodP: Food a Colony Connector moves per minute from a colony with spare food to one that needs it.
antcolonies.configuration.connectorShare: Whether colonies joined by a Colony Connector may put resources into each other's Resource Piles.
antcolonies.configuration.eggHatchMinute: Average minutes until an egg hatches into a larva.
antcolonies.configuration.farmerByproduc: Garden harvests (mushrooms, seeds, berries) per minute per effective farmer.
antcolonies.configuration.farmerFood.too: Food per minute per effective farmer, before the species' own food production.
antcolonies.configuration.fightRolls.too: Simulated hunts per minute per effective soldier, before soldier strength.
antcolonies.configuration.foodUpgradeSav: Share of food saved per Food Efficiency Upgrade tier (at most 75% in total).
antcolonies.configuration.generatorOutpu: FE a Generator makes per tick while it burns fuel (one coal burns for 1600 ticks).
Most FE a Generator gives to the blocks around it per tick.
antcolonies.configuration.idleActivity.t: How much an ant without a job eats, compared to a busy one.
antcolonies.configuration.inheritanceVar: Chance per trait that a daughter Queen's level differs by one from her mother's.
antcolonies.configuration.interval.toolt: Ticks between colony simulation steps. Larger steps cost less and give the same totals.
antcolonies.configuration.labCostMultipl: Multiplier on Genetic Laboratory material costs (rounded up, at least 1).
antcolonies.configuration.labTimeMultipl: Multiplier on Genetic Laboratory processing times.
antcolonies.configuration.larva.tooltip: Food a larva eats per minute.
antcolonies.configuration.larvaeGrowMinu: Average minutes until a larva becomes an adult (before genetics and nurseries).
antcolonies.configuration.maintenanceFra: Share of a colony's adults that must stay home to clean tunnels and tend the brood. Workers kept for maintenance are never assigned to a job; too few of them lower colony health.
antcolonies.configuration.maxBeneficialM: Most beneficial mutations one Queen can carry (flaws don't count).
antcolonies.configuration.maxColonyPopul: Hard cap on the adults of one colony, whatever its housing.
antcolonies.configuration.maxLevelMultip: Effect of a trait at the maximum level.
Highest level the Genetic Laboratory can raise a trait to.
Most animated ants drawn in one Terrarium (they only show the colony; they never decide anything).
antcolonies.configuration.nestCooldownSe: Seconds a wild nest needs to recover after ants were taken from it.
antcolonies.configuration.nestQueenChanc: Chance Tweezers pull a Queen instead of workers from a wild nest.
antcolonies.configuration.networkScanLim: Most blocks (tubes, tunnels, structures) one colony's network may hold.
antcolonies.configuration.noBreedingCham: Egg laying speed of a Queen without any Breeding Chamber.
antcolonies.configuration.nurseryGrowthB: Larvae growth speed added by each Ant Nursery (diminishing).
antcolonies.configuration.nurseryLarvaeC: Larvae each Ant Nursery holds on top of the Terrarium's own room.
antcolonies.configuration.offlineCatchUp: Minutes of simulation a colony catches up on when its Terrarium loads again after being unloaded. Production never runs while unloaded; this is the most it can make up afterwards (0 = none).
antcolonies.configuration.populationExpo: Diminishing returns: n ants on one kind of job (all of a colony's sites of that kind together) work like n^exponent ants.
antcolonies.configuration.processingPerW: Items a Resource Processing Chamber processes per minute per effective worker.
antcolonies.configuration.queen.tooltip: Food a Queen eats per minute.
antcolonies.configuration.queenChance.to: Chance a naturally spawned wild ant is a Queen.
antcolonies.configuration.queenRearingMi: Adults a colony needs before its Queen Chamber can raise a new Queen.
antcolonies.configuration.rareFindMultip: Multiplier on the chance of every rare ("special") find: diamonds, netherite scrap, shells, sponges, sniffer eggs... 0.5 halves them, 0 turns them off, 2 doubles them. Common finds are not changed (lower scavengeRolls for those). Fighting Site loot comes from mob loot tables and is not affected (use fightRolls).
antcolonies.configuration.resourcePileSl: Resource Pile slots unlocked per Storage Upgrade tier (base 9, at most 54).
Scavenging finds per minute per effective worker, before the species' own rate.
antcolonies.configuration.simulationUpgr: Extra catch-up minutes from a Simulation Upgrade of tier 1, 2 and 3.
antcolonies.configuration.siteBaseCapaci: Ants one job site takes before Population Upgrades.
antcolonies.configuration.siteCapacityPe: Ants each Population Upgrade tier adds to a job site.
antcolonies.configuration.soldier.toolti: Food a fighting soldier eats per minute.
antcolonies.configuration.soldierCasualt: Chance a hunt costs one soldier, before the soldiers' strength.
Chance a naturally spawned wild ant is a soldier.
antcolonies.configuration.soldierCost.to: Soldiers a colony gives up for one Guard Ant (a Rally Pheromone used on its Terrarium).
antcolonies.configuration.spawnChance.to: Chance a natural spawn attempt of a wild ant succeeds (0 turns them off).
antcolonies.configuration.speciesUpgrade: Strength of species-specific upgrades per tier.
antcolonies.configuration.speedUpgradeBo: Work speed added per Speed Upgrade tier.
antcolonies.configuration.stagePopulatio: Adults a colony needs for stages 2, 3 and 4 (stage 2 also needs a Breeding Chamber, stage 3 a Nursery, stage 4 a mineral or better species, or average genetics of 5 or more).
antcolonies.configuration.startingLevelW: Weights of starting trait levels 1 to 10 for a new wild Queen.
antcolonies.configuration.starvationDecl: Share of the population lost per minute of starvation after the grace period.
antcolonies.configuration.starvationGrac: Minutes without food before the population starts to die.
antcolonies.configuration.starvationKill: Whether a Queen dies once her colony has starved down to nothing.
Work, egg laying and growth speed of a colony without food.
Ants working on top of job sites.
antcolonies.configuration.terrariumCapac: Adults a Terrarium houses on its own.
antcolonies.configuration.terrariumFoodC: Food a Terrarium stores on its own.

species.antcolonies.abyssal.desc: A hybrid of Shore and Lapis Ants that dives for the ocean monuments' treasures: prismarine, sea lanterns and sponges.
species.antcolonies.aluminum.desc: Light, quick Iron Ants fed aluminum. Bring aluminum.
species.antcolonies.amethyst.desc: Living geodes that glow violet in the dark. Prefer to live underground.
species.antcolonies.badlands.desc: Rust-red ants of the badlands. Bring red sand and terracotta in all the badlands colors, and a little gold.
species.antcolonies.blossom.desc: Pink ants of cherry groves and flower meadows. Bring flowers for every dye, petals, cherry wood and honeycomb.
species.antcolonies.certus.desc: Amethyst Ants fed certus quartz. Bring certus quartz for Applied Energistics, and fluix at stage 3.
species.antcolonies.coal.desc: Soot-black ants evolved from Stone Ants fed coal. A steady supply of fuel for furnaces and Generators.
species.antcolonies.common.desc: The starting species of plains and forests. Brings back soil, seeds, sticks and odds and ends.
species.antcolonies.copper.desc: Evolved from Stone Ants fed copper. Their shells go green with age, like old roofs.
species.antcolonies.crimson.desc: A hybrid of Farmer and Fire Ants that grows Nether fungus. Tends Farmer Gardens for food, wart and shroomlight.
species.antcolonies.crystal_wood.desc: A hybrid of Wood and Diamond Ants: forest ants whose bark has turned to crystal.
species.antcolonies.deepslate.desc: Stone Ants that went down. Live best underground; bring deepslate, tuff, dripstone and glow lichen.
species.antcolonies.desert.desc: Fast, heat-loving ants of deserts and badlands. Bring sand, sandstone and cactus, and sometimes gold.
species.antcolonies.diamond.desc: Rare crystal ants grown from Gold or Lapis lines. Bring diamond fragments; whole diamonds at stage 3.
species.antcolonies.emerald.desc: Gem-backed ants evolved from Diamond Ants. Bring emerald fragments.
species.antcolonies.ender.desc: Amethyst Ants changed by eyes of ender. Black with violet eyes; bring end stone, chorus and ender pearls, and very rarely shulker shells.
species.antcolonies.excavator.desc: A hybrid of Desert and Deepslate Ants that digs like an archaeologist: bones, pottery sherds, ancient seeds, even sniffer eggs.
species.antcolonies.farmer.desc: Leafcutters that grow fungus gardens. Their Farmer Gardens feed their own colony and, through Colony Connectors, others.
species.antcolonies.fire.desc: Desert Ants fed blaze powder. They glow like coals and bring the Nether's fuels: blaze powder, magma, wart and quartz.
species.antcolonies.fluorite.desc: Amethyst Ants fed fluorite. Bring fluorite for Mekanism's chemistry.
species.antcolonies.frost_emerald.desc: A hybrid of Snow and Emerald Ants that grows emeralds in the cold.
species.antcolonies.gold.desc: Gilded ants of hot lands. Their nuggets come compressed to ingots with Processing upgrades.
species.antcolonies.harvester.desc: A hybrid of Farmer and Savanna Ants, after the real seed-storing harvester ants. Tend Farmer Gardens for crops of every kind.
species.antcolonies.honeypot.desc: A hybrid of Blossom and Farmer Ants. Some workers swell into living honey jars: honey, sugar and comb. Tends Farmer Gardens.
species.antcolonies.iron.desc: Evolved from Stone Ants fed iron. Their armoured bodies shine like polished metal.
species.antcolonies.jungle.desc: Busy ants of the jungle canopy. Bring jungle wood, bamboo, vines, cocoa and melon.
species.antcolonies.lapis.desc: Deep blue ants with lapis plates. Gather lapis lazuli.
species.antcolonies.lead.desc: Heavy, slow Iron Ants fed lead. Bring lead.
species.antcolonies.mechanical_miner.des: A hybrid of Stone and Redstone Ants: tireless miners that bring a bit of everything.
species.antcolonies.netherite.desc: The end of the line: heat-forged ants of the Nether. Very slow, very hungry, and the only ants that find netherite.
species.antcolonies.nickel.desc: Iron Ants fed nickel. Bring nickel.
species.antcolonies.obsidian.desc: A hybrid of Stone and Fire Ants: where lava meets stone. Bring obsidian, basalt and magma; crying obsidian at stage 3.
species.antcolonies.osmium.desc: Stone Ants fed osmium. Bring osmium for Mekanism's machines.
species.antcolonies.pale.desc: Ghost-white ants of the pale garden. Bring pale oak, pale moss and resin, and the odd eyeblossom.
species.antcolonies.redstone.desc: Glowing red ants that hum with energy. Gather redstone and, at higher stages, glowstone.
species.antcolonies.reef.desc: A hybrid of Shore and Jungle Ants, as bright as a coral reef. Bring living coral blocks and fans of all five colors.
species.antcolonies.savanna.desc: Large, bold ants of the savanna. Strip acacia, gather grain and pick over what the herds leave: bones, feathers, hide.
species.antcolonies.sculk.desc: A hybrid of Deepslate and Soul Ants from the deep dark. Bring sculk, sensors and catalysts, and the rare echo shard.
species.antcolonies.shore.desc: Beachcombing ants that work the tideline. Bring sand, kelp and ink, then prismarine and, rarely, nautilus shells.
species.antcolonies.silver.desc: Lead Ants fed silver; they shine like mirrors. Bring silver.
species.antcolonies.snow.desc: Pale ants of the frozen north that thrive where others freeze. Gather snow and ice.
species.antcolonies.soul.desc: Fire Ants touched by soul fire. Live best in the Nether; bring soul sand, basalt and blackstone, and ghast tears.
species.antcolonies.stone.desc: Tough mountain ants that tunnel through rock. Bring stone, gravel and the odd mineral; the start of every mineral line.
species.antcolonies.swamp.desc: Mud-coated ants of swamps and mangroves. Bring clay, mud, sugar cane and lily pads, and in time slime.
species.antcolonies.tin.desc: Copper Ants fed tin: together they make bronze. Bring tin.
species.antcolonies.uranium.desc: Lead Ants fed uranium. They glow green in the dark; bring uranium.
species.antcolonies.wood.desc: Red-chested forest builders of the taiga. Gather logs, sticks and saplings.
species.antcolonies.zinc.desc: Copper Ants fed zinc, ready for Create's brass. Bring zinc.
